scope: Two existing provider references for all-provider Account Connect. Public documentation/source GET only; no account API calls, login, runtime, private files, key creation, purchases or code changes.

providers.product: Kimi Code / Kimi Coding; Moonshot Open Platform remains separate

current.credential: Owned api-key or read-only legacy API-key snapshot import; no qualified Kimi OAuth login/refresh adapter
current.monitoring: KimiQuotaAdapter supports only own official https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1 or https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1 credential base URL; GET matching /usages with Bearer same key. Custom gateway keys never sent to official host.
current.identity: Existing account/route IDs and private API-key material remain intact; do not force key-to-OAuth migration. AccountService canonicalizes kimi.ai but does not currently canonicalize kimi.com by host.

preferredFlow.existingAccount: Reuse existing matching Coding key, read quota; no extra login or key creation.
preferredFlow.newAccount: Offer official device-code account login as concrete candidate; direct public OAuth toolkit owner or official CLI-owned local integration require focused qualification. No key creation is needed for evidenced official OAuth inference.
preferredFlow.status: Research proposal; official native device login and same OAuth-token use evidenced, lain gateway qualification not implemented
preferredFlow.oneCredential: Existing key serves both; OAuth access token serves both in official client, refresh stays with one owner.

userSteps.action: Select Kimi Code and purpose. Existing configured Coding account connects immediately without another login.
For new account choose Mit Kimi anmelden, open device verification URI (complete URL when supplied), sign in/approve; lain polls at provider interval, displays expiry/cancel.
Auth owner stores OAuth material, or references official CLI-owned local server. Read quota and show connected identity plus timestamp; do not infer successful models from login/models_ready.

Expose models only after transport/admission qualification; otherwise retain successful usage connection and offer existing Coding key. Nur Nutzung creates no model route/key and does not run inference.

credentials.refresh: Replacement only on conscious user action

credentials.owner: Either qualified lain OAuth owner OR official Kimi CLI, never competing refresh owners
credentials.use: Official client resolves access token as inference API credential and /usages Bearer
credentials.storage: Owned protected credential store; monitor receives access projection, not refresh material

credentials.owner: Official kimi-code server; lain holds protected connector reference
credentials.use: Experimental localhost auth/usage API, broad agent server authority
credentials.lifetime: Token rotation invalidates all running local instances; local connector detach must not rotate/logout globally

inference.existing: Preserve configured harness/transport and Coding endpoint, do not route Moonshot API key to Coding endpoint.
inference.oauthEvidence: Python official CLI sets managed Kimi provider with empty static key + OAuth ref; OAuthManager resolves access token into chat client key. New official kimi-code also supports managed auth, ACP and agent-session API.
inference.keyBootstrap: Not required for evidenced Coding OAuth path; do not invent key mint/reveal step.
inference.qualification: Documented local server is an agent/session runtime with tools, not an evidenced drop-in OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy. Direct access-token gateway and allowed harness/version semantics must be qualified before claiming lain model access.
inference.entitlement: No purchases, Booster enablement or paid/API fallback implied by Connect.

monitoring.operation: GET {own qualified Coding base}/usages, Authorization: Bearer <key/access token>
monitoring.native: Ratios remain percentages; use reset timestamps, show only present windows. Current adapter handles legacy exactly-one-limit fallback conservatively.
monitoring.oauthDelegated: GET /api/v1/oauth/usage via authenticated official local server -> code=0 AND data.kind=ok, quota.usages limit5h/limit7d/monthTotal/monthCode, nullable extraUsage booster wallet. kind=error can occur inside successful envelope.
monitoring.monitorOnly: Reuse existing key/OAuth session without key creation/reveal. Starting official login can change CLI configuration/default model, so isolate owner config or disclose/use already-running owner; never silently run CLI login as a read-only operation.
monitoring.scope: Current lain adapter does not expose Booster wallet. Moonshot CN/international PAYG balance is a different product and not established by successful Coding /usages.
monitoring.disconnect: Local detach leaves official CLI logged in. Explicit official logout removes managed provider and may tear down machine Remote Control.

maintainerPrerequisites: Qualify one direct OAuth owner using published toolkit, or a version-pinned official local server connector and its startup bearer handoff. No manual cookie/refresh file copying.

Check applicable provider client-use/admission terms for own distributed integration. No public own-client enrollment procedure established; do not invent blanket registration requirement or copy client identity as automatically authorized.
Add owned/delegated Kimi credential kind, refresh serialization, cancellation and account identity binding before OAuth quota projection; existing api-key path remains unchanged.
Treat regional .com/.ai, auth host, Coding vs Open Platform explicitly; fix host canonicalization in a separately approved implementation without changing existing account IDs.
unresolved: Direct lain OAuth distribution/client admission and harness compatibility; public source exports device toolkit, which is stronger evidence than an undocumented copied endpoint.
Official Python kimi-cli and newer TypeScript kimi-code have different homes/versions; never assume interchangeability or scan either real credential directory.
Direct monitor-only OAuth login must avoid official login side effects on shared model/default config; local bearer has broader authority than quota-only.

fallback.existing: Keep existing Coding API key flow; same-key quota, no forced login.
fallback.new: Offer Coding key entry as fallback if OAuth transport not yet qualified; Platform API-key variant separately labelled and does not inherit Coding quota.
fallback.partial: Retain successful monitoring if model transport remains unqualified; unknown quota is not zero.

codeImplications: Do not replace KimiQuotaAdapter or external snapshots with unowned refresh. Add qualified account connect/owner and pass limited credential projection.
Preserve .com/.ai endpoint checks, native stable window identities, last-success/stale semantics.
Model-configured, login-valid, quota-read and inference-tested are separate states; connecting does not launch chargeable test.

sources.claim: Kimi Code OAuth device login and Platform API key are distinct login choices.
Experimental authenticated local server: device login lifecycle, native plan windows/booster, agent sessions; models_ready does not verify credentials.
Official CLI owns login/config; local bearer startup and rotation, documented third-party API integration.
Public browser-safe device module explicitly exports request, poll and refresh; consumers store token themselves.
Official OAuth host and official Kimi client flow configuration; public identifier is evidence, not automatic authorization to impersonate this client.
Official .com/.ai Coding endpoints, /usages Bearer access token, native ratio windows and booster schema.
Python CLI device authorization, token grant/refresh, OAuth access token injected into inference provider; login changes CLI config/default model.
Distinct Coding API and Moonshot CN/international Open Platform endpoints; models fetched with resolved OAuth access token.

providers.product: International Z.ai GLM Coding Plan (personal/team separated); standard API and CN BigModel are distinct

current.credential: Owned api-key and read-only legacy snapshot import; no qualified ZCode OAuth/PAT owner
current.monitoring: ZaiQuotaAdapter GET https://api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit using raw same API key in Authorization; accepts only exact official international credential base URL paths.
current.native: CREDIT_LIMIT credits, TOKENS_LIMIT tokens, TIME_LIMIT requests; units/window identities preserved.
current.limits: CN open.bigmodel.cn/dev.bigmodel.cn and team project headers/type=2 are not currently qualified; standard-key endpoint acceptance does not prove Coding entitlement.

preferredFlow.existingAccount: Reuse matching key and same-key quota; no extra browser login.
preferredFlow.newAccount: Concrete official ZCode-style browser init/poll -> OAuth -> business JWT -> org/project Key ID -> short-lived Project Access Token candidate. Does not require user copy a long-lived raw API key.
preferredFlow.status: Official implementation evidenced; lain/client admission and distribution qualification remain. Coding Tool Helper itself only configures user-supplied key.
preferredFlow.preConnectDisclosure: Modelle und Nutzung may create a dedicated project Key record if no eligible record exists and issue short-lived tokens; disclose before conscious Connect.

userSteps.action: Choose international personal/team Coding product and purpose; existing matching key gets quota without new login.
For new OAuth candidate create ephemeral polling secret, start CLI pairing, open returned HTTPS authorize_url, sign in/approve, poll until ready/failed/expiry/cancel.
Owner binds ready.user.user_id, exchanges OAuth for business JWT and discovers eligible org/project. Auto-select only unique/confirmed intended scope; multiple team/projects need chooser.

For models-and-usage reuse dedicated Key ID or consciously create lain record after client-use qualification, issue short-lived project token; pass same live token to qualified model and quota clients.

For usage-only reuse existing eligible request material without creation; when no such material/read-only path qualified, keep account-login success separate and offer existing key or Console. Show quota-read/model-configured independently.

credentials.owner: Single qualified auth owner or official delegated ZCode integration
credentials.use: Exchange for business login; not directly substitute for inference API key
Separate product session token returned alongside provider OAuth; not inference key
Org/project metadata and PAT issuance; raw vs Bearer is operation-specific
Short-lived model and quota request credential
credentials.lifetime: Validate accessToken, tokenType Bearer, positive expiresIn/expiresAt, enable; earliest expiry, single-flight renewal and explicit rejected generation handling

inference.existing: Keep existing configured API-key transport. Coding vs standard API and user entitlement remain distinct.

loginBootstrap.init: POST https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/oauth/cli/init; body {provider:zai}; Authorization Bearer <random 32-byte ephemeral polling token>
loginBootstrap.poll: GET https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/oauth/cli/poll/{flow_id}; same poll token; init response authorize_url, expires_at, flow_id, poll_interval_sec; ready token + user + zai.access_token (+ optional refresh_token)
loginBootstrap.businessLogin: POST https://api.z.ai/api/auth/z/login body {token: OAuth access token} -> data.access_token/accessToken with expiry metadata
loginBootstrap.keyRecord: GET /api/biz/v1/organization/{org}/projects/{project}/api_keys; only if needed models-and-usage POST same path {name, usageScene:1}; official personal name zcode-api-key/team zcode-team-api-key and keyType:2 for team
loginBootstrap.importantField: apiKey returned by Key lookup/create is non-secret Key ID, not usable long-lived inference secret
loginBootstrap.issuance: POST /api/biz/v1/organization/{org}/projects/{project}/api_keys/{id}/access_tokens with Bearer business JWT and official clientType/clientVersion -> data.accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, expiresAt, optional enable
loginBootstrap.status: Request/response corroborated in official source; no endpoint called in this research. Official clientType=zcode is not evidence lain may impersonate it.

inference.entitlement: PAT remains subject to official version/request admission. No hidden plan reset/upgrade, purchase, wallet spend/fallback or standard API promotion.

monitoring.reader: GET /api/monitor/usage/quota/limit; raw request credential in Authorization, without added Bearer prefix
monitoring.oauthEvidence: Official current quota provider resolves accountRequestAuthService for usage, then sends auth.apiKey raw. Correlated PAT migration source says issued token serves former API-key business interfaces; same token capability is evidenced within official client.
monitoring.team: Official code adds bigmodel-organization/bigmodel-project and type=2 to quota path for team; separate scope and not current lain coverage.
monitoring.monitorOnly: Never call generic resolveMaterial blindly: key-location lookup falls through to Key creation. Separate noncreating lookup/issuance path or existing user key. Issuing an allowed short-lived token may be required by read-only auth, but must not create/reveal/rotate a long-lived Key or mutate model config.
monitoring.native: Render only returned windows, keep type/unit/number identity, ratio/reset timestamps and last-success freshness. No synthesized monthly remaining from local usage.
monitoring.excludedWrites: Do not expose reset, purchase, off-peak settlement or other writes merely because official quota service includes them.

maintainerPrerequisites: Qualify either own integration against real provider client-use/admission rules or supported delegation to official auth owner. Public source is concrete feasibility evidence; no blanket separate registration requirement proven.
Define separate login, business-token, project-token owners and limited quota projection; do not save PAT as static api-key and lose renewal/expiry.
Own client name/usageScene/project selection and team role rights must be verified. Never send clientType=zcode or reuse official app callback/client identity without establishing supported use.
Keep monitor-only code path noncreating; normal official login invokes material resolution and changes standalone config/default model, unsuitable as opaque read-only command.
Keep region/product, own endpoint, Org/Project/Key-ID and login generation in cache identity; old in-flight token failures must not delete newer sessions.
unresolved: Supported own-client admission/distribution or bounded CLI delegation interface; source implementation alone is not a published third-party auth contract.
Pure monitor-only first connect without existing Key-ID may need a different read-only business-token quota route; not evidenced here. Do not implement implicit key creation or call it impossible.
Independent refresh lifetime of Z.ai OAuth vs business JWT vs PAT, cancellation/logout contract and team role rights need focused qualification.
CN BigModel source shares machinery but different hosts/auth/region; does not extend current international adapter by inference.

fallback.existing: Use existing key for both model and quota, no forced new login.
fallback.new: Fallback to explicitly labelled Personal/Team Coding key input and documented Console links; Helper remains optional, not required installation.
fallback.partial: Preserve login success if quota material unavailable; do not mark inference ready merely because OAuth succeeded.

codeImplications: Add qualified login owner and typed short-lived credential projection rather than putting refresh in ZaiQuotaAdapter.
Split Key discovery/create/PAT issuance so usage-only cannot create through shared resolver. Account Connect purposes must be operation policy, not labels only.
Add explicit team qualification before team headers/type=2, preserve existing raw-auth same-key flow and exact official origin checks.
Existing snapshot import remains read-only; never scan actual ZCode credential files or assume imported key proves ownership of browser identity.

sources.claim: Personal vs Team Coding Plan key locations, Anthropic endpoint and same configured key.
Helper asks user to supply API key; wizard automation does not itself establish OAuth/key creation.
Official quota GET uses raw configured inference key; international and CN hosts are separate.
CLI init/poll native browser pairing, ephemeral poll secret and ready OAuth token/user material.
Login resolves Coding material, persists OAuth identity, runtime exchanges; not long-lived derived API key storage. Also changes CLI config/default model.
OAuth -> /api/auth/z/login business JWT -> project access token resolver; single owner, cached business token, no model replay.
Org/project discovery, dedicated Key ID lookup/create, short-lived access_tokens issuance. apiKey field is ID, not inference secret.
Strict enable/accessToken/tokenType/expiresIn/expiresAt response; expiry, cache, rejection/refresh rules.
Actual quota reader resolves account request auth, raw Authorization, team org/project headers and type=2 query; includes write actions that lain read-only monitor must not expose.
Desktop authorization-code routes and ZCode callback/client identity; not a generic third-party registration contract.
Official repository explains implemented migration: same issued token for model and former API-key business interfaces; official-version safety admission still applies.
